content: Akʉmara nikiigwa riraka ikʉrʉ kurwa mwihekaaru rɨkabhʉʉrɨra bhamaraika muhungatɨ bharya, “Mujɨ mwitɨrɨ kʉʉsɨ mabhakuri muhungatɨ gʉ ʉbhʉrʉrʉ bhwa Mungu.”
Maraika we embere akaja, akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ. Hayohayo, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhʉ ʉrʉkaamʉ rwu ugutyɨnyi na bhanʉ bhaasɨngɨɨrɨ risambwa ryazɨ, bhakabha na amahutɨ amabhɨ.
Neho maraika wa kabhɨrɨ wʉʉsi akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ mʉnyanza. Amanzi gakabha amasaahɨ ncha amasaahɨ gɨ ɨkɨtʉndʉ, ni ibhityɨnyi bhyʉsi ɨbhɨhʉru mʉnyanza bhɨkakwa.
Neho maraika wa katatʉ wʉʉsi akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ mʉkɨtaarʉ nɨ ɨkɨsɨɨzɨ cha amanzi, na amanzi gʉʉsi gakiichʉra gakabha amasaahɨ.
Akʉmara nikiigwa maraika umwimiiririri wa amanzi, arabhuga,

content.text: na zɨtɨnɨrʉ zaazʉ zɨnʉ, ne‑ze eheene.
Kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ abhabhɨ bhayo bhakiitɨra
ɨkɨsaahɨ cha abharɨndu bhaazʉ na abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhaazʉ,

content: Neho nikiigwa riraka kurwa ahagero hu ukuhurukirya ikimweso rɨrabhuga,

content.text: zɨtɨnɨrʉ zaazʉ ne‑ze eheene na za amaheene.”

content: Neho maraika wa kane akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ kuryʉbha. Iryʉbha rɨkahaabhwa ʉbhʉnaja bhu ukwocha abhaatʉ komorero gwaryo.
Abhaatʉ bhakʉʉkibhwa kɨbhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Bhakatʉka Mungu, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ nʉ ʉbhʉnaja igʉrʉ wa amacha ganʉ, nawe bhataatigirɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ na bhataamukumiryɨ.
Neho maraika wa kataanʉ akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ kukitumbɨ chʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwu ugutyɨnyi. Rogendo rʉmwɨ ikiirimya kɨkakundikirya ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazɨ na abhaatʉ bhakarʉma zɨndɨmɨ zaabhʉ kʉbhʉsʉngʉ.
Bhakatʉka Mungu wa mwisaarʉ kʉ kʉbha yʉ ʉbhʉsʉngʉ bhʉhaari na amahutɨ amabhɨ gaabhʉ. Nʉʉrʉbhu bhataatigirɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ.
Neho maraika wa kasaasabha wʉʉsi akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ kʉkɨtaarʉ ɨkɨkʉrʉ cha Ɨfuraati, amanzi gakʉʉma, korereke ɨnzɨra ekorebhwɨ kʉbhatɨmi bha kurwa rʉgʉrʉ.
Neho nɨkarora amasambwa amabhɨ atatʉ ganʉ gatuubhɨɨnɨ ni ibhyʉra, gakarwa mumunywa gwo ogozoka, na mumunywa gwu ugutyɨnyi, na mumunywa gwʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri wʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ wurya.
Amasambwa ganʉ gaarɨ nʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwo okokora ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ, ne emeremo jagʉ ni‑kuja kʉbhatɨmi bhʉʉsi kʉʉsɨ kʉbhabhiringa igʉrʉ wa riihɨ urusikʉ ʉrʉkʉrʉ rwa Mungu wʉ Ʉbhʉnaja Bhwʉsi.
Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu arabhuga, “Morore! Nɨraaza nchu umwibhi. Hakɨrɨku wʉnʉ atɨngɨzirɨ abhanwirɨ zengebho zaazɨ korereke ataaza kogenda tʉʉhʉ na kʉsʉʉka.”
Mmbe amasambwa gayo gakabhiringɨra abhatɨmi bhʉʉsi na abhasirikarɨ bhaabhʉ ahagero hanʉ kʉKɨɨbhuraaniya hakubhirikirwa Harimagɨdʉʉni.
Neho maraika wa muhungatɨ akiitɨra ɨbhakuri yaazɨ kʉmʉkama. Na niinyɨ nikiigwa riraka ikʉrʉ kurwa kukitumbɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi cha rihekaaru, rɨrabhuga, “Gʉʉsi gasirirɨ!”
Hakabha na zɨmbaryʉ, ɨmɨbhagatyʉ jʉ ʉrʉkʉbha, nɨ ɨɨsɨ ɨkarigita bhʉkʉngʼu. Ikirigitʉ kiyo charɨ kɨkʉrʉ kʉkɨra bhyʉsi kwɨma ukubhumbwa kʉmʉʉtʉ.

Neho ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉkʉrʉ rwa Bhaabhɨɨri rʉkatwanɨkana mbaara isatʉ na zɨmbɨri zɨkʉrʉ zi ibhyarʉ zɨkasarɨka zʉʉsi. Kwɨbhu Mungu akahiita ʉbhʉsarya bhwʉsi bhwa Bhaabhɨɨri, akarunywɨsha ekekombe chi idivaayi yʉ ʉbhʉrʉrʉ bhwazɨ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ.
Ikirigitʉ kirya kɨkagirya amaginga gʉʉsi gakangʼosa, nɨ ɨbhɨgʉrʉ bhyʉsi bhɨtaarʉrɨkɨɨnɨ kwikɨ.

Imbura yo omosoke ɨkatweka. Omosoke muritʉ ncha kirʉ merongo ɨtaanʉ kwa gʉmwɨ, gʉkagwɨra abhaatʉ kurwa kwisaarʉ. Abhaatʉ bhakatʉka Mungu igʉrʉ wa amacha gi imbura ya amabhwɨ, kʉ kʉbha gaarɨ amacha amabhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu.

footnotes.text: Ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri wʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ wurya, ni‑gutyɨnyi gwa kabhɨrɨ, gʉnʉ gʉkahʉrʉka kurwa kʉʉsɨ ne emeremo jagwɨ jarɨ kurimirya abhaatʉ na amangʼana gaagwɨ. Rora Ubhwɨrɨkibhwa 13:11‑15.
